title: Replay export cannot restore a valid pristine pinned state
description: ReplayProtector.export_state emits a pinned pristine window with highest=-1 and bitmap=0, but import_state rejects that exported form because imported windows require highest>=0/bit0 and pin ownership requires a window. This violates the exact snapshot/restore contract. Define and implement one canonical pristine-pinned representation or omit it consistently, then add exact round-trip tests without enabling live rollback.
